subtitle: Create or touch up a player YAML, one option at a time, with a live preview.

start.title: Pick a game to start
start.body: The Studio starts from the game's template: every option at its default, for you to adjust.

player.title: Player
player.name: Player name
player.nameHint: 16 characters at most. {number} becomes a number when the name is already taken.

game.label: Game
game.loadError: The list of games could not be read
game.multi: This file picks its game at random among several, and is saved as it is. Picking a game here makes it a YAML of that game alone: its section becomes editable, the others stay in the file.
game.noneBody: Install Archipelago, or a world, to create a YAML.
game.changeBody: The options of {{from}} will be replaced by those of {{to}}, at their defaults.
game.schemaError: The template of {{game}} could not be read

templates.title: No template for {{game}} yet
templates.body: Archipelago can write a template for each of your installed worlds. The Studio will then offer every option of this game.
templates.fallback: Meanwhile, the options already in the file can still be edited as YAML.

presets.label: Presets
presets.hint: A preset starts over from the game's defaults.

options.unknownHint: This game's template does not know these options: they are kept as they are.
options.fileHint: Without a template, each option is edited as YAML.

option.randomBody: Archipelago will pick the value when it generates the game.
option.textHint: One of the suggested values, or your own text.
option.rawHint: In YAML: a list (“- item”) or “key: value” pairs.
option.rawLocked: This value does not fit the visual control: it stays as YAML.
option.weightsHint: The bigger a weight, the more likely its value is picked.

preview.title: YAML preview
preview.empty: The preview shows up as soon as you pick a game.
preview.error: The preview could not be computed

reasons.empty-list: an empty list leaves nothing to pick
reasons.weight: each weight must be a positive number
reasons.negative-random-range: Archipelago misreads a negative random-range: it always picks the last bound
reasons.merge-tag: Archipelago does not read YAML merges (<<)
reasons.format: a brace stands alone: write it twice to keep it in the name
reasons.aliases: too many nested YAML aliases (& and *)

save.invalidRawBody: Fix it before saving: otherwise that option would be lost.

session.title: Add to a game
session.body: The YAML is copied into the chosen game, like a dropped file.
session.emptyBody: Create a game from the Game screen, then come back to add this YAML.

load.failed: This YAML could not be opened
load.unreadable: This file does not read as a player YAML

discard.title: Discard your changes?
discard.body: The current YAML is not saved: its changes will be lost.
